question: Anup can row 33 km downstream and 35 km upstream in 8 hours. He can also row 44 km downstream and 28 km upstream in the same time. How much time (in hours) will he take to row 55 km downstream and 14 km upstream?
solution:
**Given data:**

 
 

 
 
Downstream distance

 
 
 
Upstream distance

 
 
 
Time

 
 
 

 
 
33 km

 
 
 
35 km

 
 
 
8 hours

 
 
 

 
 
44 km

 
 
 
28 km

 
 
 
8 hours

 
 
 

 
 
55 km

 
 
 
14 km

 
 
 
 

 
 
 

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of river be “x” and speed of boat be “y”.

Effective downstream speed = x + y

Effective upstream speed = x – y

33over x+y+ 35 over x-y = 8 (Eq. 1)

44over x+y + 28over x-y= 8 (Eq. 2)

Subtracting equation 1 from equation 2-

⇒ 44over x+y - 33over x+y + 28over x-y - 35 over x-y= 0

⇒ 44over x+y - 33over x+y = 35 over x-y - 28over x-y

⇒ 11over x+y = 7over x-y

⇒ 11 × (x - y) = 7 × (x + y)

⇒ 11 x - 11y = 7x + 7y

⇒ 4x = 18y

⇒ x = 9over 2y.

Putting the value of "x" in equation 1-

⇒ 33over {9yover 2}+y + 35over {9yover 2}-y = 8

⇒ 66over 11y + 70over 7y = 8 or 6over y + 10 over y = 8

⇒ y = 2 

Substituting the value of "y" in the value of "x" = 9

∴ Time required for 55 km downstream and 14 km upstream distance = 55over x+y+ 14over x-y

⇒ Time required for 55 km downstream and 14 km upstream distance = 55over 9+2+ 14over 9-2= 5 + 2 = 7 hours

**The total time required for the distance to be traveled is 7 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Here, according to the question, 

⇒ 33/(x + y) + 35/(x - y) = 8 & 44/(x + y) + 28/(x - y) = 8

As the number of required hours is a complete number hence 

The values of (x + y) & (x - y) should divide the respective numbers

For Downstream, that is 33 and 44 both are multiples of 11

and for Upstream, that is 35 and 28 both are multiples of 7

By value putting method, 

⇒ 33/11 + 35/7 = 3 + 5 = 8 & 44/11 + 28/7 = 4 + 4 = 8

⇒ x + y = 11 & x - y = 7

Required time, 

⇒ 55/11 + 14/7 = 5 + 2 = 7 hours

∴ The total time required for the distance to be traveled is 7 hours.
